question: Should this PR remain the final stacked feed/follow/notification branch, or should it be reduced to feed routes after the narrower follow graph, controls, and notification PRs are reviewed?
rationale: The title is feed-route focused, but the branch includes durable private follow state, notification fanout, public API surface, and UI changes that overlap open draft PRs and require maintainer ownership of rollout order.

options.title: Keep as final stacked branch
options.body: Let the base follow graph, controls, and notification work clear first, then rebase this PR and prove the full feed/follow/notification behavior together.

options.title: Split to feed routes only
options.body: Narrow this PR to canonical feed URLs and metadata while leaving follow graph, controls, and notification fanout to the existing narrower drafts.

options.title: Pause until direction is settled
options.body: Leave this draft parked until maintainers decide the account/publisher feed product boundary and API rollout sequence.

recommendation.title: Keep as final stacked branch
recommendation.body: Let the base follow graph, controls, and notification work clear first, then rebase this PR and prove the full feed/follow/notification behavior together.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-main history across the route, ApiRoutes, schema-package, and publish-path surfaces this stacked PR extends.
